import sys
input = sys.stdin.read
data = input().strip().split()
n = int(data[0])
m = int(data[1])
k = int(data[2])

if k < n - 1:
    # Moving down the first column
    print(k + 1, 1)
else:
    # Adjust k to reflect the movement after reaching the bottom left corner
    k -= (n - 1)
    full_zigzags = k // (m - 1)
    remaining_steps = k % (m - 1)
    
    if full_zigzags % 2 == 0:
        # Moving right in this zigzag
        col = 2 + remaining_steps
    else:
        # Moving left in this zigzag
        col = m - remaining_steps
    
    row = n - full_zigzags
    print(row, col)
